corp.name: NVIDIA
corp.body: Semiconductor & AI chip maker. One of the most prominent tech corporate backers.

corp.name: Toyota Ventures
corp.body: Corporate VC arm of Toyota. Led by Jim Adler. AI for physical reasoning aligns with automotive/robotics vision.

corp.name: Sea
corp.body: Singapore-based tech conglomerate (Shopee, Garena, SeaMoney). Also relevant to AMI's Singapore hub.

corp.name: Temasek
corp.body: Singapore sovereign wealth fund. Long-term strategic investor.

corp.name: Groupe Industriel Marcel Dassault
corp.body: French industrial group — aviation and defense.

corp.name: Association Familiale Mulliez
corp.body: French family holding (Auchan, Decathlon, and more).

corp.name: Artémis

corp.name: Bpifrance Digital Venture
corp.body: French public investment bank's digital venture fund.

corp.name: ZEBOX Ventures

vc.name: Bezos Expeditions
vc.body: Jeff Bezos's personal investment vehicle, acting as a VC fund.

vc.name: Cathay Innovation
vc.body: Global VC with offices in Paris, SF, Berlin, Madrid, Singapore, Shanghai. Managing Partner: Jacky Abitbol. VP: Jonathan Healy.

vc.name: Greycroft
vc.body: New York VC (~$2B+ AUM). Co-led by Dana Settle (Co-Founder & Managing Partner, now AMI Board Member). Partners: Conor Deveney, Jim Murphy.

vc.name: Hiro Capital
vc.body: London/Luxembourg VC. Focus: Spatial Computing, Physical AI, Robotics, Gaming, Defense. Managing Partner: Luke Alvarez. GP: Sir Nick Clegg.

vc.name: Eurazeo
vc.body: French global PE/VC group (~€35B AUM). Team includes Benoist Grossmann, Nicolas Debock, Tara Reeves.

vc.name: daphni
vc.body: French VC — second-largest French institutional investor. Invested via daphni Blue & Dastore. Team: Léopold Treppoz, Paul Chatton, Maxime UBEDA.

vc.name: Alpha Intelligence Capital (AIC)
vc.body: Advisors include Yann LeCun and Pascale Fung. Co-founders: Charles-Edouard Bouée, Antoine Blondeau, Arnaud Barthelemy.

vc.name: Aglaé Ventures
vc.body: LVMH-linked venture fund. French strategic investor.

vc.name: 20VC
vc.body: GP Julien Codorniou invested through prior relationship with LeBrun (Microsoft France, Facebook/Wit.ai, Nabla).

vc.name: Headline
vc.body: International VC. GP Jonathan Userovici invested at seed stage. Portfolio: Mistral AI, Black Forest Labs, Bioptimus.

vc.name: Serena
vc.body: French deeptech VC. Senior Associate Juliette Ast led the investment. Connection through Yann LeCun's open-source LinkedIn posts.

vc.name: Founders Future
vc.body: French VC. Team: Marc Menasé, Sophie Duval, Matthieu Benkerant, Louis Sautet.

vc.name: Drysdale Ventures
vc.body: Founder: Nicolas Essayan. Co-invested alongside Xavier Niel and AGLAÉ Ventures.

vc.name: firstminute capital
vc.body: London seed VC ($500M AUM, backed by 130+ unicorn founders). Partner Sam Endacott invested.

links.name: Resonance
links.body: French early-stage VC (€50M fund, pre-seed/seed European AI). Partner & co-founder Maxime Le Dantec.

links.name: Shorooq
links.body: Abu Dhabi VC (~$1B AUM, backed by Mubadala, QIA, PIF, ADQ). Partner Bilal Baloch led AI investments.

links.name: C4 Ventures
links.body: Leading European venture firm backed by former Apple and Microsoft executives. A team of business operators backing ambitious tech entrepreneurs.

angel.name: Jeff Bezos
angel.body: Amazon founder. Invested both personally and through Bezos Expeditions.

angel.name: Eric Schmidt
angel.body: Former Google CEO. Significant personal participation. Named across all press coverage.

angel.name: Mark Cuban
angel.body: Entrepreneur, minority owner of the Dallas Mavericks. Named in PitchBook and multiple LP announcements.

angel.name: Xavier Niel
angel.body: French tech billionaire, founder of Iliad/Free. Major French tech angel investor.

angel.name: Tim Berners-Lee

angel.name: Rosemary Berners-Lee
angel.body: Invested jointly with Tim Berners-Lee.

angel.name: Jim Breyer

angel.body: CEO & co-founder of Batch (450+ EU brands). Prolific early-stage investor in French tech. Connected Adrien Aumont to AMI.

angel.name: Briac Lescure

angel.name: Gaultier Brun

angel.name: Amaury Roland

angel.name: Antoine Loron

angel.name: Damien Dupouy

angel.name: Thibaut Angevin

angel.name: Alexandre Rousseau

angel.name: David Sainteff

angel.name: Jonathan Userovici

angel.name: Maxime Paradis

angel.name: Maxime UBEDA

angel.name: Ulysse Laroche

angel.body: School drop out | Defeated injustice | 1 IPO | 4 Exits.
